articles.title: Oil falls as Trump downplays prospect of escalation with Iran
articles.description: Oil prices fell due to President Trump's announcement regarding US military action against Iran, easing supply concerns. Brent crude futures dropped to $92.33 per barrel while WTI futures reached $86.50. Trump stated he would maintain a naval blockade in the Strait of Hormuz temporarily. OPEC's oil output increased in October, supported by higher production from Saudi Arabia and Kuwait.

articles.title: US troops entering Iran through Iraq? What Iraqi PM claims to have seen in Trump’s war plan with 3 military scenarios
articles.description: Iraqi PM Ali al-Zaidi has reportedly told political allies that Trump was presented with a US war plan outlining three possible military scenarios. Two involve US forces entering southern Iran through Iraq and Iran potentially using Iraqi territory to launch an incursion into Kuwait.

articles.title: Iraqi PM discloses details of Trump's 'leaked' Iran war plan
articles.description: Iraq's Prime Minister, Ali al-Zaidi, claims a leaked US war plan involves American forces entering Southern Iran via Iraq and Tehran pressuring Baghdad to invade Kuwait.

articles.title: Iraqi PM claims to have seen Trump's Iran war plan. What's in it?
articles.description: US Iran War News: Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi has reportedly told political allies that he saw a leaked war plan presented US President Donald Trump, envisaging American troops entering southern Iran through Iraq, as well as another scenario involving Tehran using Iraqi territory to move against Kuwait. The revelations come as Baghdad struggles to maintain neutrality amid the ongoing US-Iran War.
